invariants.Source raw note: E2E validation must include pinning and unpinning files between nodes.
invariants.Expected behavior: A block fetched from another node and explicitly pinned remains listed as pinned, and Docker multi-node e2e proves add, fetch, pin-list, and unpin.
invariants.Disallowed shallow implementation: Only adding content locally or assuming fetch equals pin without checking pin listing on the remote node.
invariants.Production assertions: repo://src/CanDoItAll.IPFS.Engine/CoreApi/PinApi.cs restores the pin after remote block fetch so pin state survives the fetch side effect.
invariants.Red-team negative case: bundle://proof/SB09/transcripts/focused-pin-regression-after-remote-pin-fix.txt asserts the fetched CID appears in Pin.ListAsync on the second node.
invariants.Downstream dependency check: bundle://proof/SB09/transcripts/docker-multinode-e2e.txt proves the same behavior across Docker nodes.

invariants.Source raw note: Run multiple nodes in docker and validate pinning/unpinning files between nodes.
invariants.Expected behavior: Docker e2e starts two nodes, connects them, adds and pins content on node A, fetches and pins on node B, verifies pin listing, then unpins on node B.
invariants.Disallowed shallow implementation: A single-node compose smoke or a two-node start that never verifies remote pin list/unpin behavior.
invariants.Failing-first test: N/A process/non-production exemption: Docker e2e is a release validation script; negative behavior would be a failed e2e transcript.
invariants.Production assertions: repo://docker-compose.yml provides persisted production topology; bundle://proof/SB09/docker-compose.e2e.yml exercises the same Engine image across two Docker nodes.
invariants.Red-team negative case: bundle://proof/SB09/transcripts/docker-multinode-e2e.txt fails if peer connection, remote fetch, pin list, unpin, or persistence checks fail.
invariants.Downstream dependency check: bundle://proof/SB09/docker-multinode-e2e-summary.json records node IDs, CID, and true persistence/pin booleans.
